description: This header file defines the CloudStore class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the class as a plugin implementing JSON-RPC and plugin interfaces, with nested classes for configuration and notifications related to store events and remote connection status. The file sets up class members, interface mappings, and method signatures for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.

classes.name: CloudStore
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing plugin and JSON-RPC interfaces, managing store notifications and remote connection events.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Nested class for configuration parameters, specifically the URI for the CloudStore.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Notification class for handling store value changes, forwarding events to the parent CloudStore.

classes.name: RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Notification class for handling remote connection activation and deactivation events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the CloudStore plugin with the provided service.
